port.name: Transformers Armada Recomp
port.description: Transformers (PS2, 2004, also known as Transformers Armada: Prelude to Energon) as a native Windows game, made by static recompilation from your own disc, with a native Direct3D 12 renderer, high resolutions up to 4K, ultrawide, high frame rates and HD textures made from your own disc.
requirements: A graphics card with DirectX 12 and Vulkan
Your own disc image (.iso) of Transformers for the PS2
port.installation_notes: Download the setup from the releases page, run it, pick your own disc image and an install folder, then press Install. The setup contains no game data: it builds the game on your PC from your disc.

compatibility.notes: The whole game is playable from start to finish. A native Linux and Steam Deck version is also available (./setup.sh, ./play.sh).
